other_failure_modes.name: Transductive imputation on test set
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using the test set's own statistics (e.g., median) rather than the statistics learned from the training set, causing data leakage.

other_failure_modes.name: TypeError in categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to map categorical columns using a sklearn LabelEncoder object with pandas .map(), which expects a dict, Series, or function. Passing a LabelEncoder object directly will raise a TypeError.

other_failure_modes.name: Invalid early stopping without validation set

summary: The agent sets up a basic LightGBM regressor with cross-validation but introduces multiple critical execution errors and data leakages. Applying LabelEncoder via pandas `.map()` and using early stopping without a validation set will immediately crash the script. Additionally, imputing the test set with its own median causes transductive data leakage, and imputing before CV splitting compromises the validation scores. No feature engineering is performed.
